description.text: 这一组句型帮助学习者先交代人物、事物或概念是什么，再补充它现在怎么样、来自哪里，或某个词具体指什么。
This group helps learners say who or what a person, thing, or idea is, then add its state, background, or meaning more clearly.
把主语和身份、状态、特征连起来，说明“是什么 / 怎么样”。这里用肯定说法。
Links the subject to an identity, state, or quality — what it is or how it is. This side is the affirmative form.
表示肯定、确认或直接陈述某事成立。
Marks a positive statement, confirmation, or direct assertion that something holds true.
把主语和身份、状态、特征连起来，说明“是什么 / 怎么样”。这里用否定说法。

表示否定、不存在、不发生或不允许，常见于 not、never、no 等结构。
Marks negation, absence, non-occurrence, or prohibition, often signaled by not, never, or no.
表示和“指示”有关的主语，也就是谁或什么处在这种情况里。
Shows the subject connected with demonstrative: who or what is in that situation.

Shows the noun phrase that says what something is, what kind it is, or what it is called.

Background adjunct for an action or state: often a PP (place, company, setting), and also a reduced V-ing circumstance adjunct (e.g. entering Atlantic Daylight Time / walking home), kept inside the clause rather than promoted.
